messages:
Nora (Design): Dropping a smaller follow-up from the trace viewer review. Main asks: breadcrumb trail inside drilldown (so users can jump up the service chain), export confirmation UX (size estimate + cost hint), and contrast nits on the corr-id/permalink affordances. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/trace-breadcrumbs-v2
Vikram - Eng: Breadcrumbs make sense. Implementation note: when users click a breadcrumb we should preserve any current filters (time range, error filters) via query params so they don't lose context. Also avoid a full page reload; do a shallow route change.
Jana - PM: For exports, product wants an explicit confirm step for full traces: show estimated size, approximate time, and a small cost hint (e.g., "This export may incur additional egress charges for large traces"). Quick summary should remain one-click.
Marta (A11y): Accessibility nits: breadcrumb links need clear focus states and aria-current on the active crumb. Corr-id chips must have an accessible name e.g., 'Correlation id 12345, press Enter to copy'. Permalink tooltips should be announced when focus arrives via a polite live region.
Nora (Design): On contrast: current corr-id chip uses mid-gray text on light gray bg. Proposing 4.5:1 contrast for chip text and 3:1 for the chip border in compact mode. Also adding a subtle copy icon inside the chip to surface affordance.
Vikram - Eng: Copy behavior: on desktop use navigator.clipboard.writeText with a fallback. On iOS Safari we need a selectable input fallback because clipboard API is flaky. Also ensure we do not steal focus on copy; show a non-intrusive toast instead.
Jana - PM: About permalink perms: Hosted orgs = stable permalinks (mask internal ids), Dedicated/Private = ephemeral links via signed tokens TTL=3600s. For ephemeral permalinks show '(expires in 1h)' in the toast.
Marta (A11y): Live-region content examples: 'Export started: preparing file', 'Export 30% complete', 'Export ready: click to download'. Keep announcements short to avoid screenreader spam. For the confirm modal ensure role=dialog and focus is trapped when the modal opens.
Nora (Design): Breadcrumb UX: show chain like Service A > Service B > Request ID. Each crumb should have a small chevron and a hover preview popover showing last error sample. Popover must be optional on mobile.
Vikram - Eng: Popover note: avoid heavy previews for very large traces; only load a 200-char sample. Popover requests should debounce 300ms to avoid extra load when users hover across rows.
Jana - PM: Acceptance criteria: 1) breadcrumb nav with preserved filters and shallow routing 2) corr-id chip with high-contrast variant + inline copy icon + accessible name 3) export flows: quick summary one-click, full export confirm with size estimate/time/cost hint + cancelable streaming download + SSE progress + org gating 4) permalinks per org type + toast messaging 5) a11y checklist attached to ticket (focus order, aria-current, live-region examples).
Marta (A11y): Keyboard shortcuts: when a trace row has focus: Enter = open, C = copy corr-id (announce 'copied' in live-region), B = focus breadcrumbs. Document conflict matrix and ensure scoping to the trace container only.
ops-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/trace-breadcrumbs-export-confirm-v1.png
Nora (Design): I'll push updated frames with contrast variants, the breadcrumb hover preview spec, and microcopy for the export confirm modal. Please flag any infra blockers asap.
Vikram - Eng: Scheduling a 20m handoff Wed 9am. I'll add backend tickets: share-token endpoint, export size estimator header, SSE progress stream, and confirm gating by org flag.
Jana - PM: Thanks everyone. I'll add the acceptance criteria to the ticket and require the accessibility checklist be completed before merge.
